cases.name: new-en-match
cases.quick_take: META's gain comfortably exceeded SPY's, but holding it meant accepting a rough ride. The 18.35% worst drop is a reminder that a strong finish did not make this a smooth experience.
cases.breakdown:
The annualized return was 117.25%, while volatility was 38.17%. Those figures describe a large gain with substantial swings along the way.

For scale, an 18.35% fall applied to the $10,000 starting capital is about $1,835. This is an illustration of the drop's size, not the actual loss from the portfolio's later peak. The recorded Sharpe ratio was 2.22, and the run recorded one trade.
